Ukrainian forces recently advanced northeast of Lyman and east of Oleksandrivka.

Read more here: https://t.co/pN4QnEiv2p

Ukrainian forces conducted long-range strikes against Russian defense industrial facilities and oil infrastructure in Russia overnight on October 8 to 9. Russian forces launched 136 drones against Ukraine overnight.
Russia is likely attempting to indigenize the production and assembly of key Geran-type strike drone components in cooperation with the People’s Republic of China (PRC).
